title: 聊天首 token · 同型号人工调参
description: 用户显示耗时为体验依据；供应商值仅诊断。缺报不算成功，只比较同一型号。没有自动调参/告警写入。

list.name: model
list.label: 型号（每次只比较一个）
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT requested_model_id AS __text,requested_model_id AS __value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE NOT billing_rejected ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 用户总首 token p90 与兜底替代比例（同一型号）

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'), percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY client_first_token_visible_ms) FILTER (WHERE client_backgrounded=false) AS "用户总首 token p90", 100*avg((COALESCE(delivery_role,'')='fallback')::integer) AS "兜底选用率", 100*count(*) FILTER(WHERE delivery_role='fallback' AND client_outcome='observed')::numeric/NULLIF(count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed'),0) AS "可见样本中兜底占比" FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND requested_model_id = ${model:sqlstring} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 超时率、1% 目标与回报覆盖率（缺报不算成功）

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'), 100*count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='timed_out' AND client_backgrounded=false)::numeric/NULLIF(count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome IN ('observed','timed_out') AND client_backgrounded=false),0) AS "前台已知结果超时率", 100*avg((client_outcome<>'missing')::integer) AS "回报覆盖率",100*avg(timeout_rate_target) AS "人工目标" FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND requested_model_id = ${model:sqlstring} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 每 24h 人工比较：总体 150 门槛与参数分组样本

targets.rawSql: SELECT j->>'model_id' AS "所选型号",(j->>'model_requests')::int AS "型号总体请求",(j->>'sample_eligible')::boolean AS "总体达到150",(j->>'requests')::int AS "本参数组请求",(j->>'primary_timeout_ms')::int AS "首发等待ms",(j->>'catalog_version')::int AS "目录版本",(j->>'user_first_token_p90_ms')::numeric AS "用户总首token_p90_ms",100*(j->>'fallback_start_rate')::numeric AS "兜底启动率%",100*(j->>'foreground_timeout_rate_observed')::numeric AS "前台已知结果超时率%",100*(j->>'client_report_coverage')::numeric AS "回报覆盖率%",(j->>'primary_censored_or_unknown')::int AS "首发未测得精确值" FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_report($__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) j WHERE j->>'model_id'=${model:sqlstring}

panels.title: 首发与兜底：后端实测和供应商自报分开对照

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'), percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY primary_actual_first_token_ms) AS "首发实测 p90",percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY primary_provider_latency_ms) AS "首发供应商 p90", percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY fallback_first_token_ms) AS "兜底实测 p90",percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY fallback_provider_latency_ms) AS "兜底供应商 p90" FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND requested_model_id = ${model:sqlstring} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 缺报、未观测、后台与超时数量

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'),count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='missing') AS "缺报",count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='not_observed') AS "未观测",count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_backgrounded=true) AS "曾进入后台",count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='timed_out') AS "客户端超时",count(*) FILTER(WHERE server_first_token_timeout) AS "服务端首token超时" FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND requested_model_id = ${model:sqlstring} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 原始事实（最近 100 轮；NULL 保留）

targets.rawSql: SELECT request_received_at,chat_history_id,primary_timeout_ms,catalog_version,client_outcome,client_backgrounded,delivery_role,client_first_token_visible_ms,primary_wait_ms,fallback_dispatch_delay_ms,fallback_first_token_ms,primary_actual_first_token_ms,primary_end_reason,primary_provider_latency_ms,fallback_provider_latency_ms,client_display_delay_ms,client_server_residual_ms FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND requested_model_id = ${model:sqlstring} ORDER BY request_received_at DESC LIMIT 100
